en: The postcard depicts an old black-and-white photo of Sundsvall's harbor, showing several boats docked along the quay and a prominent stone building to the left. The background features a hillside with houses. The text 'Motiv från hamnen' and 'Sundsvall' appears at the top. Handwriting overlays the image with a personal message, and 'Henning Johansson' is written in blue on the side of a boat. The reverse side contains handwritten text, an address to Albin J. Sparring, and a green Swedish postage stamp dated 1912.
